*.forwards: address hand-off on every handle class

GstMapInfo.forwards: a struct the caller allocates for gst_buffer_map: flags, data (a copy of the mapped bytes), size and maxsize as properties; the native map stays in the object for gst_buffer_unmap

GstMessage.forwards: the struct's public fields, read live (GST_MESSAGE_TYPE, GST_MESSAGE_TIMESTAMP, GST_MESSAGE_SRC)

GstBuffer.forwards: the struct's public fields, read live (GST_BUFFER_PTS, GST_BUFFER_DTS, GST_BUFFER_DURATION, GST_BUFFER_OFFSET)

GstVideoInfo.forwards: the struct's public fields, read live; finfo as its GstVideoFormat (GST_VIDEO_INFO_FORMAT), stride and offset as lists of GST_VIDEO_MAX_PLANES ints

GstAudioInfo.forwards: the struct's public fields, read live; finfo as its GstAudioFormat (GST_AUDIO_INFO_FORMAT)
